residual_variations: Palm foliage in the generated views is denser/fuller than the thin procedural proxy; A remains somewhat fuller than C, but it stays a tabletop accessory and no floor-route obstruction is introduced. Live-plant appearance and spread require a field check.

Aeron and visitor-chair cushion/mesh/frame silhouettes, drawer seams, shelf lips and cat upholstery/branch detail vary modestly from the proxy and product photographs; these concepts do not replace the product selections or native fit proofs.
Rug, wood grain, art brushwork, brick pattern, daylight, globe glow and exterior scenery are photorealistic generated interpretations.
Camera B can suggest a narrow wall-floor finishing strip; source workwall baseboard geometry is unrecorded, so this is a generated finishing detail, not measured architecture.
superseded_attempts: Initial repeated Camera A outputs and oversized-palm candidates are excluded from acceptance and retained only in generation-manifest history/checkpoints.
